name: Bob Navigation Hotkeys
description: Ctrl+Shift+P opens a Task Card first screen with exact P-level previews, classic search, and automatic activation from 2026-10-19. Open and manage related notes, tabs, and task properties, including priority levels that roll scheduled dates. Ctrl+Enter on scheduled takes the recommended roll, decay, or cancel from the previewed ladder, including counted and Task Link batches. On a prioritized task the scheduled row opens first and selected. Scheduling a Pending or Next task offers an optional Work Log summary recorded as a dated entry under a WORK LOG child. A pinned Cancel row closes tasks as Cancelled with an optional reason kept in a first-child Cancel Log. Alt+F and Alt+Shift+F ask for an optional Work Log summary before refreshing Pending tasks.
author: Bryan
